correctness.rationale: The class-size and pairwise-intersection hypotheses force a simple 2-regular bipartite incidence graph. Its connected components are side-labelled even cycles; decomposition gives an exact partition bijection. All admissible structures have identical four joint binary counts at every element so ordinary stable C2 refinement is monochromatic; explicit C2 sentences force any equivalent two-equivalence structure back into the same family. Side-preserving automorphisms are edge-transitive on each even cycle and permute equal-size components, yielding d(lambda) orbits. The minimum distinct-part sum d(d+3)/2 proves the sharp extremal formula. Independent graph isomorphism and automorphism enumerations checked the boundary cases.
